sources.title: ENERGY STAR · 旅宿业能源特征评估
sources.title_en: ENERGY STAR · Lodging energy use profiling
sources.section: How to profile your energy use
sources.excerpt: 酒店应结合自身物业条件定制能源计划；实际能耗随气候区域、所装设备与业务活动水平而变化。
sources.excerpt_en: Hotels should tailor an energy plan to their specific property; energy use varies with climate, installed equipment, and business activity.
sources.summary: 酒店应结合自身物业条件定制能源计划；实际能耗随气候区域、所装设备与业务活动水平而变化。
sources.summary_en: Hotels should tailor an energy plan to their specific property; energy use varies with climate, installed equipment, and business activity.

sources.title: ENERGY STAR · 酒店节能运营建议
sources.title_en: ENERGY STAR · Tips for saving energy at your hotel
sources.section: Tips for saving energy and money at your hotel
sources.excerpt: 运营措施涵盖客房、大堂与走廊照明升级及自然采光利用、基于入住状态的客房控制、走廊定时调光结合感应控制（避免走廊全黑）、高效热水系统，以及密封门窗和暖通空调缝隙。
sources.excerpt_en: Operational tips include lighting upgrades in guestrooms, lobbies, and halls, using daylight, occupancy-based guest-room controls, hallway scheduling and dimming with occupancy controls to avoid dark hallways, efficient water heating, and sealing door, window, and HVAC gaps.
sources.summary: 运营措施涵盖客房、大堂与走廊照明升级及自然采光利用、基于入住状态的客房控制、走廊定时调光结合感应控制（避免走廊全黑）、高效热水系统，以及密封门窗和暖通空调缝隙。
sources.summary_en: Operational tips include lighting upgrades in guestrooms, lobbies, and halls, using daylight, occupancy-based guest-room controls, hallway scheduling and dimming with occupancy controls to avoid dark hallways, efficient water heating, and sealing door, window, and HVAC gaps.

sources.title: EPA WaterSense · 酒店用水结构与管理计划
sources.title_en: EPA WaterSense · Hotel water uses and management plan
sources.section: Hotels — Water use profile and management plan
sources.excerpt: 酒店主要用水分布在卫生间、洗衣房、景观绿化与厨房；指南建议制定水管理计划，评估用水状况并持续跟踪结果，同时评估洗衣房与餐饮服务的改进机会。
sources.excerpt_en: Major hotel water uses include restrooms, laundry, landscaping, and kitchens; facilities should develop a water management plan, assess water use, track results, and evaluate laundry and food service for opportunities.
sources.summary: 酒店主要用水分布在卫生间、洗衣房、景观绿化与厨房；指南建议制定水管理计划，评估用水状况并持续跟踪结果，同时评估洗衣房与餐饮服务的改进机会。
sources.summary_en: Major hotel water uses include restrooms, laundry, landscaping, and kitchens; facilities should develop a water management plan, assess water use, track results, and evaluate laundry and food service for opportunities.

sources.title: EPA WaterSense · 酒店节水器具与检漏维护
sources.title_en: EPA WaterSense · Hotel fixtures and leak maintenance
sources.excerpt: 日常节水运维包括排查漏水并及时修复，以及选用高效卫浴器具。
sources.excerpt_en: Routine water-saving operations include checking for leaks and repairing them promptly, alongside using efficient bathroom fixtures.
sources.summary: 日常节水运维包括排查漏水并及时修复，以及选用高效卫浴器具。
sources.summary_en: Routine water-saving operations include checking for leaks and repairing them promptly, alongside using efficient bathroom fixtures.

sources.title: ENERGY STAR · 旅宿业能效与节水巡检清单
sources.title_en: ENERGY STAR · Hotel energy and water efficiency checklist
sources.section: Pages 2–3: Lighting assessment, sensors, and daylight controls
sources.excerpt: 清单第 2–3 页建议评估高效照明配置，识别并评估低人流区域安装占用/动作感应器的机会，并分别评估自然采光调光控制机会。
sources.excerpt_en: Pages 2–3 advise assessing efficient lighting opportunities, identifying and assessing opportunities for occupancy/motion sensors in low-traffic areas, and separately daylight dimming controls.
sources.summary: 清单第 2–3 页建议评估高效照明配置，识别并评估低人流区域安装占用/动作感应器的机会，并分别评估自然采光调光控制机会。
sources.summary_en: Pages 2–3 advise assessing efficient lighting opportunities, identifying and assessing opportunities for occupancy/motion sensors in low-traffic areas, and separately daylight dimming controls.

sources.title: EPA WaterSense · H2Otel 节水挑战与评估工具
sources.title_en: EPA WaterSense · H2Otel Challenge and assessment worksheets
sources.excerpt: 酒店运营方可借助 WaterUSE 工具和评估工作表，识别并确定节水改进机会的优先级。
sources.excerpt_en: Hotel operators can use WaterUSE and assessment worksheets to identify and prioritize water-efficiency opportunities.
sources.summary: 酒店运营方可借助 WaterUSE 工具和评估工作表，识别并确定节水改进机会的优先级。
sources.summary_en: Hotel operators can use WaterUSE and assessment worksheets to identify and prioritize water-efficiency opportunities.

claims.title: 结合物业条件定制能源计划
claims.title_en: Tailor the energy plan to the property
claims.text: 酒店应根据自身物业特点定制能源计划；实际用能会随气候条件、设备配置与业务活动水平而变化。
claims.text_en: A hotel should tailor its energy plan to the specific property because energy use varies with climate, equipment, and business activity.
claims.statement: 酒店应根据自身物业特点定制能源计划；实际用能会随气候条件、设备配置与业务活动水平而变化。
claims.statement_en: A hotel should tailor its energy plan to the specific property because energy use varies with climate, equipment, and business activity.

claims.title: 识别四大主要用水区域
claims.title_en: Identify four major hotel water-use areas
claims.text: EPA WaterSense 指出酒店的主要用水区域涵盖卫生间、洗衣房、景观绿化与厨房。
claims.text_en: EPA WaterSense identifies restrooms, laundry, landscaping, and kitchens as major hotel water uses.
claims.statement: EPA WaterSense 指出酒店的主要用水区域涵盖卫生间、洗衣房、景观绿化与厨房。
claims.statement_en: EPA WaterSense identifies restrooms, laundry, landscaping, and kitchens as major hotel water uses.

claims.title: 制定水管理计划并评估洗衣与餐饮
claims.title_en: Build a water plan and evaluate laundry and food service
claims.text: 酒店应制定水管理计划，评估用水现状并跟踪结果，同时评估洗衣房和餐饮服务中的节水机会。
claims.text_en: Hotels should develop a water management plan, assess water use and track results, and evaluate laundry and food service for improvement opportunities.
claims.statement: 酒店应制定水管理计划，评估用水现状并跟踪结果，同时评估洗衣房和餐饮服务中的节水机会。
claims.statement_en: Hotels should develop a water management plan, assess water use and track results, and evaluate laundry and food service for improvement opportunities.

claims.title: 升级客房、大堂与走廊照明并利用自然光
claims.title_en: Upgrade guestroom, lobby, and hall lighting and use daylight
claims.text: 在客房、大堂和走廊实施照明升级，并利用自然采光减少人工电照明需求。
claims.text_en: Upgrade lighting in guestrooms, lobbies, and hallways, and use daylight to reduce the need for electric lighting.
claims.statement: 在客房、大堂和走廊实施照明升级，并利用自然采光减少人工电照明需求。
claims.statement_en: Upgrade lighting in guestrooms, lobbies, and hallways, and use daylight to reduce the need for electric lighting.

claims.title: 配置基于入住状态的客房控制
claims.text: ENERGY STAR 建议采用基于入住感应的客房控制策略，减少空置期间的不必要用能。
claims.text_en: ENERGY STAR recommends occupancy-based guest-room controls to curb unnecessary energy use when rooms are unoccupied.
claims.statement: ENERGY STAR 建议采用基于入住感应的客房控制策略，减少空置期间的不必要用能。
claims.statement_en: ENERGY STAR recommends occupancy-based guest-room controls to curb unnecessary energy use when rooms are unoccupied.

claims.title: 走廊定时与调光结合感应以避免全黑
claims.title_en: Pair hallway scheduling and dimming with occupancy controls
claims.text: 走廊可将定时控制、调光与占用感应结合使用，在降低能耗的同时避免出现完全黑暗的走廊。
claims.text_en: Combine hallway scheduling and dimming with occupancy controls so corridors save energy while avoiding totally dark hallways.
claims.statement: 走廊可将定时控制、调光与占用感应结合使用，在降低能耗的同时避免出现完全黑暗的走廊。
claims.statement_en: Combine hallway scheduling and dimming with occupancy controls so corridors save energy while avoiding totally dark hallways.

claims.title: 结合高效热水与高效卫浴器具
claims.title_en: Combine efficient water heating and bathroom fixtures
claims.text: 运营阶段可推进高效水加热措施，并在卫生间配置高效节水卫浴器具。
claims.text_en: Operations can combine efficient water heating practices with efficient bathroom fixtures.
claims.statement: 运营阶段可推进高效水加热措施，并在卫生间配置高效节水卫浴器具。

claims.text: EPA WaterSense 强调定期检查漏水点并及时修复，防止持续性的水资源浪费。
claims.text_en: EPA WaterSense emphasizes checking for leaks and repairing them promptly to prevent ongoing water loss.
claims.statement: EPA WaterSense 强调定期检查漏水点并及时修复，防止持续性的水资源浪费。

assets.question: 如何制定酒店能源与节水基线计划？
assets.question_en: How should a hotel build an energy and water baseline plan?
assets.text:
# 物业用能与用水基线盘点单（自建练习样例）

- 记录所在气候区、主要设备清单与旺淡季业务活动特征。
- 按卫生间、洗衣房、景观绿化与餐饮厨房梳理用水观察项，建立水管理计划跟踪表。
- 注：本件为项目自建 Markdown 运维练习模板，不包含任何真实酒店能耗或水表实测数据。
assets.text_en:
# Property energy and water baseline worksheet (self-authored sample)

- Record climate context, major equipment inventory, and business activity patterns.
- Map water review items across restrooms, laundry, landscaping, and kitchens to set up a water management tracking plan.
- Note: Self-authored Markdown operational practice template; contains no measured hotel utility data.

assets.title: 客房与公共区照明控制巡检卡（自建练习样例）
assets.title_en: Guestroom and public-area lighting control card (self-authored sample)
assets.question: 客房、大堂和走廊可以采取哪些照明与控制措施？
assets.question_en: What lighting and control measures apply to guestrooms, lobbies, and hallways?
assets.text:
# 客房与公共区照明控制巡检卡（自建练习样例）

- 核对客房、大堂与走廊照明升级范围，标记可利用自然采光的公共区域。
- 检查客房入住感应控制逻辑，以及走廊定时调光与占用感应联动，确保走廊不会处于全黑状态。
- 注：本件为项目自建 Markdown 巡检练习卡，非真实酒店运行记录或节能担保。
assets.text_en:
# Guestroom and public-area lighting control card (self-authored sample)

- Review lighting upgrade areas across guestrooms, lobbies, and hallways, and note daylit zones.
- Check occupancy-based guest-room controls and hallway scheduling/dimming paired with occupancy sensors so hallways never go totally dark.
- Note: Self-authored Markdown inspection practice card, not real hotel logs or guaranteed savings.

assets.title: 检漏、热水与围护密封维护记录表（自建练习样例）
assets.title_en: Leak repair, water heating, and sealing log (self-authored sample)
assets.question: 日常节水与维护如何处理漏水及门窗暖通缝隙？
assets.question_en: How does routine maintenance address water leaks and HVAC door or window gaps?
assets.text:
# 检漏、热水与围护密封维护记录表（自建练习样例）

- 排查卫生间与后勤管线漏水点并记录及时修复情况，核对高效卫浴器具与高效水加热设备状态。
- 检查门框、窗缝与暖通空调接口密封条，封堵气流泄漏缝隙。
- 注：本件为项目自建 Markdown 维护记录模板，不含实测读数或投资回报测算。
assets.text_en:
# Leak repair, water heating, and sealing log (self-authored sample)

- Inspect restrooms and service lines for leaks, log prompt repairs, and check efficient bathroom fixtures and water heating equipment.
- Inspect door frames, windows, and HVAC joints to seal air gaps.
- Note: Self-authored Markdown maintenance template with no measured readings or ROI estimates.
